mobsettings.configuration.title: Mob Settings
mobsettings.configuration.dropOnlyOnPlay: Extra Drops Only On Player Kill
Extra drops are only given when a player gets the kill.
mobsettings.configuration.extraDrops.too: Give mobs additional drops with a chance.
mobsettings.configuration.removeDrops.to: Remove items from a mob's drops. Runs before Extra Drops.
mobsettings.configuration.addSpawns.tool: Make mobs spawn naturally in biomes. Runs after Remove Spawns.
mobsettings.configuration.removeSpawns.t: Stop or reduce a mob's natural spawns in biomes. Runs before Add Spawns.
mobsettings.configuration.spawnGroupSize: Change how many of a mob spawn together. Runs before Add Spawns.
mobsettings.configuration.maxGroupPlacem: The most mobs one group from Add Spawns or Spawn Group Sizes can have. Big groups go past the mob cap and can cause lag.
mobsettings.configuration.attributeOverr: Change a mob's health, speed, armor and more.
mobsettings.configuration.damageModifier: Multiply the damage a mob deals and takes.
mobsettings.configuration.experienceModi: Multiply the experience a mob drops in a dimension.
Set how far from players a mob despawns.
mobsettings.configuration.lightSpawnRest: Only let a mob spawn within a light level range.
mobsettings.configuration.experimentalIn: Experimental: /mobsettings inspect opens a screen with the mob in 3D, its gear, spawns, drops (removed ones marked) and every rule that covers it, instead of printing to chat. Operators only.
mobsettings.inspect.title: Inspect (Experimental)
mobsettings.ui.serverManaged: Mob Settings is managed by this server
mobsettings.ui.serverManaged.message: Mob Settings rules on this server are set by its operators. Your local config has no effect here. You can still edit it from the main menu for your own worlds.
mobsettings.ui.pasteLines.tooltip: Adds every line on the clipboard. Invalid lines and duplicates are skipped.
mobsettings.ui.pastedLines: Added %s, skipped %s duplicates and %s invalid lines
mobsettings.ui.pasteLines.empty: The clipboard has no lines to paste.
mobsettings.ui.group.label: %s – %s entries
mobsettings.ui.group.deleteMessage: This removes %s entries. Like other changes, it's only saved on Done.
mobsettings.ui.pickUnavailable: In a world, only operators can add from the list. You can still add entries with the Add button.
mobsettings.ui.pickHint: Select a name field to search
mobsettings.ui.any.help: Matches everything (written as * in the config).
mobsettings.ui.note.pickAttribute: Pick an attribute to see its range
mobsettings.ui.describe.extraDrops.optio: %1$s drops %3$s %2$s (%4$s chance) in %6$s, more with Looting
mobsettings.ui.describe.removeDrops.opti: %1$s loses %2$s from its drops (%3$s chance) in %4$s
mobsettings.ui.describe.addSpawns.option: %1$s spawns in %3$s in %2$s (weight %4$s, groups of %5$s-%6$s), following its usual spawn rules
mobsettings.ui.describe.spawnGroupSizes: %1$s spawns in groups of %4$s-%5$s in %3$s in %2$s
mobsettings.ui.describe.damageModifiers: %1$s deals %2$sx damage and takes %3$sx damage in %4$s
mobsettings.ui.describe.despawnRanges: %1$s stays within %2$s blocks of a player in %3$s, despawns beyond
mobsettings.ui.describe.lightSpawnRestri: %1$s only spawns at light level %2$s to %3$s in %5$s in %4$s
mobsettings.ui.help.entity: The mob this rule applies to. Use * for every mob, a #tag for a group of mobs, or modid:* for every mob from a mod.
mobsettings.ui.help.addSpawns.entity: The mob to spawn. Only mobs that can spawn naturally are listed.
mobsettings.ui.help.removeSpawns.entity: The mob whose spawns are removed. Use * for every mob.
mobsettings.ui.help.spawnGroupSizes.enti: The mob whose group size changes. Use * for every mob. Only the spawns it already has are changed.
mobsettings.ui.help.spawnGroupSizes.minG: The fewest mobs that spawn together.
mobsettings.ui.help.attributeOverrides.e: The mob this rule applies to. Use * for every mob except players.
The mob this rule applies to. Use * for every mob except players.
mobsettings.ui.help.attributeOverrides.d: The dimension the mob first spawned in. Leave empty for every dimension. The mob keeps these stats if it travels to another dimension.
The dimension the mob dies in. Leave empty for every dimension.
mobsettings.ui.help.multiplier: What to multiply the experience by. 2 doubles it, 0.5 halves it, 0 removes it.
mobsettings.ui.help.extraDrops.dimension: The dimension the mob dies in. Leave empty for every dimension.
mobsettings.ui.help.removeDrops.dimensio: The dimension the mob dies in. Leave empty for every dimension.
mobsettings.ui.help.despawnRanges.dimens: The dimension the mob is in. Leave empty for every dimension. A rule for one dimension beats a rule for every dimension.
mobsettings.ui.help.lightSpawnRestrictio: The dimension the mob spawns in. Leave empty for every dimension.
The biome the mob spawns in. Leave empty for every biome, or use a biome tag like #minecraft:is_forest.
mobsettings.ui.help.damageModifiers.enti: The mob this rule applies to. Use * for every mob except players.
mobsettings.ui.help.damageModifiers.dime: The dimension the damage happens in. Leave empty for every dimension.
mobsettings.ui.help.dealt: What to multiply the damage the mob deals by. 2 doubles it, 0.5 halves it. Leave empty to keep it. Set this or Taken.
mobsettings.ui.help.taken: What to multiply the damage the mob takes by. 2 doubles it, 0.5 halves it. Leave empty to keep it. Set this or Dealt.
mobsettings.ui.help.removeDrops.item: The item to take out of the mob's drops. Use * to remove every drop.
mobsettings.ui.help.dimension: The dimension this applies to. Leave empty for every dimension. Rules for one dimension are applied after rules for every dimension, and don't affect animals placed when chunks generate.
mobsettings.ui.help.biome: The biome this applies to. Leave empty for every biome, or use a biome tag like #minecraft:is_forest for a group of biomes.
mobsettings.ui.help.attribute: The stat to change. Only stats the chosen mob has are listed. Hover one in the list to see what it does.
mobsettings.ui.help.count: How many of the item drop. Leave empty for 1.
mobsettings.ui.help.chance: Chance to drop, from 0 to 1. 0.25 means 25%. Leave empty to always drop.
mobsettings.ui.help.removeDrops.chance: Chance the item is removed, from 0 to 1 (0.25 means 25%). Leave empty to always remove it.
mobsettings.ui.help.looting: T lets Looting add extra items: 0 to 1 per level. F or empty means no bonus.
mobsettings.ui.help.weight: How common this spawn is compared to the others in the biome. Most hostile mobs use 100, farm animals around 10.
mobsettings.ui.help.minGroup: The fewest mobs that spawn together. Leave empty for 1.
mobsettings.ui.help.maxGroup: The most mobs that spawn together. Leave empty to match the fewest.
mobsettings.ui.help.useSpawnRules: T keeps the mob's usual spawn rules, such as ground type and light level. F or empty ignores them, so it spawns anywhere it fits.
mobsettings.ui.help.percent: How much of the spawn weight to remove, from 0 to 100. Leave empty to remove the spawn completely.
mobsettings.ui.help.value: The mob's new base value for this stat. It has to be inside the stat's range.
mobsettings.ui.help.range: Distance in blocks. Within this distance of a player the mob never despawns; farther away it despawns right away.
mobsettings.ui.help.minLight: The darkest light level (0-15) the mob can spawn at. Leave empty for 0.
mobsettings.ui.help.maxLight: The brightest light level (0-15) the mob can spawn at. Leave empty for 15.
Maximum health. Each heart is 2 health.
How fast the mob walks. Most mobs are around 0.2-0.3.
Armor points that reduce incoming damage. Full diamond armor is 20.
Makes armor hold up better against big hits.
Chance to resist knockback. 1 means it can't be knocked back.
How much explosion knockback is ignored. 1 means none.
Extra knockback the mob deals with its attacks.
Damage dealt per melee hit, in half hearts.
How many blocks away the mob can notice and track targets.
Maximum golden absorption hearts the mob can have.
Size of the mob. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as big.
How tall a block the mob can walk up without jumping.
How high the mob jumps.
How fast the mob falls. Normal is 0.08; lower floats more.
Blocks the mob can fall before taking damage.
Multiplies fall damage. 0 means no fall damage.
Multiplies how long the mob stays on fire.
Makes the mob run out of air more slowly underwater.
Reduces slowdown from soul sand and similar blocks. 1 means none.
Reduces slowdown in water. 1 means none.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.player.e: How far the player can reach to interact with entities.
How fast the mob flies.
mobsettings.attribute.minecraft.zombie.s: Chance a zombie calls other zombies for help when hurt.
mobsettings.ui.error.removesEverything: This would remove every spawn. Use * for dimension and biome if that's intended
mobsettings.ui.error.badData: The data isn't valid. Open Data to fix it
mobsettings.ui.help.data.extraDrops: Set the item's enchantments, durability, name and any other data.
mobsettings.ui.help.data.addSpawns: Set the mob's worn equipment, name and any other data. It's rolled using this line's share of the mob's spawn weight where it spawns.
mobsettings.ui.data.confirmDiscard.messa: Changes made here since the last Apply will be lost.
mobsettings.ui.data.confirmClear.message: Every field on this screen will be emptied. Ctrl+Z brings it back.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.copyAll: Copy all of this data as text (Ctrl+Shift+C).
mobsettings.ui.data.help.pasteAll: Replace this data with copied text (Ctrl+Shift+V).
mobsettings.ui.data.help.apply: Hand the changes back to the rule and keep editing (Ctrl+S).
mobsettings.ui.data.help.done: Apply the changes and go back (Ctrl+Enter). Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.pasteEntry: Replace this entry with a copied id=value.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.duplicateEntry: Add a copy of this entry below it.
mobsettings.ui.data.name: Name
mobsettings.ui.data.equipment: Equipment (item | ... | drop chance | copy | paste | clear)
mobsettings.ui.data.help.item: The item. Pick one from the list, or type to search.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.damage: How much durability the item has lost. Leave empty for a new item.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.name: A custom name, shown instead of the item's own.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.others: Any other item component, such as potion_contents or lore. Write !component_id with no value to take one off.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.value: The component's value, written the way /give takes it.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.equipment: What the mob wears. Slots left empty keep the gear it would normally spawn with. Armor only shows on mobs that render it.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.slot: The item for this slot, with its data if it has any. Pick one from the list, or use ... to edit its data.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.editSlot: Edit this item's enchantments, durability and other data.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.dropChance: Chance the mob drops this item when it dies, from 0 to 1. Above 1 also keeps the item's durability. Leave empty for the usual 8.5%.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.pasteSlot: Replace this slot's item with a copied one.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.mobName: A custom name for the mob.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.persistent: The mob never despawns on its own. Many of these can slow a world down.
mobsettings.ui.data.help.otherNbt: Any other entity data, written the way /summon takes it, such as {IsBaby:1b}. UUID, Pos, Motion, Rotation and id are ignored.
mobsettings.ui.data.error.chance: Drop chance must be between 0 and 2
mobsettings.ui.slot.head: Head
mobsettings.ui.lookup.everything.removeS: Everything: stop it spawning in every dimension and biome
mobsettings.ui.lookup.everything.removeD: Everything: remove every item it drops
mobsettings.ui.lookup.noWorld: join a world to see the server's data
mobsettings.ui.lookup.noServerMod: the server doesn't have Mob Settings
mobsettings.ui.lookup.operatorsOnly: server data is for operators only
mobsettings.ui.lookup.unknownEntity: the server doesn't know this mob
mobsettings.ui.lookup.summary.drops: %s items in its loot table; equipment and picked-up items aren't listed
mobsettings.ui.lookup.empty: Nothing to add. Lines already in the list are shown greyed out, and lines your other lists don't have for this mob can't be made.
mobsettings.ui.lookup.empty.problem: Nothing to add from your configs, and no server data: %s.
